name: Xperia XZ

Body.Dimensions: 146 mm H, 72 mm W, 8.1 mm D

Platform.Operating system: Android 6.0 Marshmallow , Upgradable to Android 8.0 Oreo
Platform.CPU: Quad-core (dual 2.15 GHz + dual 1.6 GHz) 64-bit Kryo processor

Display.Display: 5.2 in 1080p IPS LCD, Full HD 1920x1080 px TRILUMINOS Display for mobile with X-Reality for mobile and Dynamic Contrast Enhancement

Cameras.Rear camera: 23 MP 1/2.3" Exmor RS for mobile sensor, BIONZ, RGBC-IR, Laser AF, Predictive Hybrid AF, Quick launch, 5x Clear Image Zoom, 24mm Wide Angle G Lens F2.0 , 4K (2160p) video recording @ 30 fps, 1080p@60fps
Cameras.Front camera: 13 MP 1/3.06" Exmor RS for mobile sensor, with Quick launch and 22mm Wide Angle Lens F2.0
